summary.text: Bill Taylor is a Republican who represents House District 86 (Aiken and Lexington Counties) in the South Carolina House of Representatives, where he has served since 2010 and sits on the Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: Taylor was born July 16, 1946, in Aurora, Illinois, and attended Bradley University, where he studied journalism.

His page lists a career as a television news director, anchor and reporter from 1965 to 1976, followed by work as a television news consultant from 1976 to 2007 and as co-founder and CEO of media research and consulting firms based in Dallas, Los Angeles and London.
In the House he served on the Education and Public Works Committee from 2010 to 2020, chaired its Higher Education Subcommittee from 2015 to 2020, and was Majority Caucus Whip from 2013 to 2016.
He moved to the Labor, Commerce and Industry Committee in 2020 and has served on Ways and Means since 2022; he is also listed as a delegate to the National Federalism Commission from 2023.
His page lists the Order of the Palmetto, awarded by Gov. Henry McMaster in 2026, and board service with the American Red Cross Aiken County Chapter and the Aiken Symphony Orchestra.
